cases.surface: The timeline is detailed, but it never says what I personally did when the situation finally changed.
I can tell who did what around me, yet my own last observable action is still missing.
Choose for me and make your instruction the decision I should obey.
I want a direct command that replaces my own judgement about which option to take.
Take the choice out of my hands and tell me the single route to follow.
This is a fabricated client scenario for classification practice, not an event from my life.
The situation below exists only as a made-up example for analysis.
What hidden intention does this person have toward me, beyond anything I can observe?
Will the outcome swing in my favour before the deadline arrives?
Will the eventual result turn out the way I hope over the next few weeks?
The main issue needed a reply, but I deliberately shifted to an unrelated task and left it untouched.
Rather than answer the central matter, I redirected my attention elsewhere and left it pending.
I checked, stepped back, then checked again, repeating the same loop without new evidence.
I made one bounded choice myself, carried it out, and did not reopen the decision.
I took a single practical step based on current information and stopped there.
